newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude eases in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude eases in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil eased in moderate U.S. paper trading late Wednesday, traders said.
A total of 12 June Brent partial cargoes traded between $17.75 and $17.80 a barrel, with a panoply of traders taking part.
The June contract on London's IPE settled at $17.81 a barrel.
May/June Brent traded at minus 31 cents a barrel, with talk around minus 32-29 cents. May/June moved earlier in the day at minus 29 cents.
June/July Brent switched hands at minus 19 cents, with the spread hovering around minus 20-17 cents. June/July traded earlier in the day at minus 15 and minus 16 cents.
